    From "I Know a Few Chords" to "Play Us Something!" — 150 Real Songs You Can Actually Play


    You don't want to "practice" guitar. You want to pick it up and play a song someone actually recognizes.

    But most songbooks hand you a page of chords and… nothing else. No strum pattern. No idea how it's supposed to sound. And the so-called "easy" ones are crammed with tab, riffs, and theory nobody ever taught you — so you flip the page, sigh, and put the guitar back in the corner.

    Weeks go by… and you're still not really playing.

    That's exactly why this songbook is different. Every one of its 150 songs is laid out so a real beginner can play it — the chords printed right above the words, a simple strum pattern, and a chord diagram for each song. If you can hold G, C, and D, you can start on page one.

    Here's why this songbook is different:
    • Chords right above the lyrics: change exactly where the word tells you — no guesswork
    • A simple strum pattern for every song: you always know how it should sound
    • A chord diagram on every song: never flip back asking "wait, how do I play that one?"
    • 150 timeless songs: folk, gospel, country, sea shanties, classics, and a full Christmas section
    • No music reading, ever: not a single note to decode — just chords, words, and play
    • Organized easiest to richest: start with 2 chords and grow without forcing it
    • A focused 20-minutes-a-day approach built for busy adult schedules
    Plus a free reader bonus pack: scan the code inside for a printable chord chart, a 4-week practice tracker, and a set of extra songs.

    Imagine sitting down after dinner, opening to any page, and playing a song the whole room knows. Someone asks, "Can you play that one?" — and you just… do it. No fumbling. No excuses. Just real music and a few surprised smiles.

    What are you waiting for? Pick up your guitar, open to song one, and play something you love today.

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Finally, Guitar Songs That Feel Achievable

    — Mark W., Beginner Guitarist

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect for Adult Beginners
    This book delivers exactly what it promises. The songs are approachable, the progression feels natural, and every page encourages you to keep practicing without feeling overwhelmed.

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Playing Real Songs from the Start
    Instead of endless exercises, this book lets you enjoy making music almost immediately. The gradual increase in difficulty keeps learning enjoyable while helping you build solid fundamentals.

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Confidence Booster for New Guitarists

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Fun Learning Experience

    — Kevin D., Adult Guitar Beginner

    About the author

    Follow authors to get new release updates, plus improved recommendations.

    Willy Vance

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Willy Vance writes practical, easy-to-follow guides designed to help adult beginners learn new skills with clarity and confidence.

    His work focuses on simplifying complex topics—especially in music and hands-on learning—by breaking them down into clear, structured steps that are easy to understand and apply. Rather than overwhelming readers with theory, his approach emphasizes real progress, consistency, and building confidence from the very beginning.

    Willy’s books are created for people with limited time who want a straightforward path to learning, without confusion or frustration.

    Through his writing, he aims to make the learning process more accessible, enjoyable, and achievable for anyone starting from zero.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.
